newsitem.title: UK: Christian Salvesen plans Aggreko float - FT.
newsitem.headline: Christian Salvesen plans Aggreko float - FT.

text.p: Scottish distribution and power supply group is to demerge its Aggreko equipment hire business and also plans a special dividend payment to shareholders, said the Financial Times newspaper.
The flotation of Aggreko would value it at about 400 million stg according to recent broker estimates, said the article.

Chris Masters, Salvesen's chief executive refused to confirm the plans, but the group is expected to announce the demerger and dividend when it presents its half year results later this month, said the paper.
Analysts expect pretax profits for the period to be up by six percent to 47.7 million.
Salvesen declined to recommend a 1.18 billion stg takeover approach from distribution group Hays last August but at the time shareholders called on the board to end three years of underperformance.
Analysts fixed on Aggreko, which hires out portable power plants and refrigeration equipment, as the probable centrepiece of Salvesen's efforts to create shareholder value, said the article.
